name: io.github.chrischall/untappd-mcp
description: Untappd MCP — search beers/breweries/venues, read check-ins & wishlists, post check-ins

environmentVariables.name: UNTAPPD_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: An Untappd access token you already hold. Supply it and no password is needed (username/password become optional).

environmentVariables.name: UNTAPPD_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Your Untappd username or login email. Required unless UNTAPPD_ACCESS_TOKEN is set.

environmentVariables.name: UNTAPPD_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Your Untappd account password (used only for xauth login). Required unless UNTAPPD_ACCESS_TOKEN is set.

environmentVariables.name: UNTAPPD_CLIENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Untappd mobile app client id (obtained by intercepting the app; see README). Needed to log in with username/password and for every write; a pre-seeded access token can read without it.

environmentVariables.name: UNTAPPD_CLIENT_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Untappd mobile app client secret. Needed to log in with username/password and for every write; a pre-seeded access token can read without it.

environmentVariables.name: UNTAPPD_DEVICE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Stable device UUID the token is keyed to (a default is provided).

environmentVariables.name: UNTAPPD_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Override the User-Agent (default mimics the app).

environmentVariables.name: UNTAPPD_TIMEZONE
environmentVariables.description: IANA timezone (e.g. America/New_York) that check-ins are stamped with when the call doesn't pass timezone. Set it when the server runs somewhere other than the drinker's zone (e.g. a hosted connector, usually UTC). Defaults to the server process's zone.

environmentVariables.name: UNTAPPD_PHOTO_DIR
environmentVariables.description: The directory untappd_checkin's photo_path must be inside (several allowed, separated by :). Defaults to ~/Downloads/untappd-mcp — put a photo there to attach it. Any other file is refused, so a prompt-injected shout or comment can't publish an arbitrary image from your disk.

environmentVariables.name: UNTAPPD_CACHE_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the local check-in cache SQLite file (default ~/.untappd-mcp/checkins.db; created owner-only — dir 0700, file 0600). Local/stdio only.
